entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.1
entry.summary: A guitar rig as one insert effect: gate, compressor, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet, post FX, modulation, delay, reverb and EQ, from the guitarix project's DSP, with guitarix's 40 factory presets. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this

entry.title: Stompbox 0.0.1 (beta)
entry.summary: > **Not a guitarix project.** I'm not affiliated with the guitarix developers. Stompbox was built with AI; please report problems [here](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-vst-stompbox/issues), not to guitarix. First release. - **Tested:** the `-mpc-armv7.zip` (Gen1) installed with its own `install.sh` on an MPC Key 37, MPC OS 3.9.1.2 (2026-10-26).
